reason: I might run the 30 free documents just to see the sheet, but I pay the contractors myself by transfer and already have the screenshots in the group. If someone double-bills me, that is my foreman's problem to answer for, not something I pay $19 a month to have flagged.
objection: It is another subscription for something I can check myself in ten minutes a week, and a duplicate means someone on site is careless or dishonest, which no bot fixes.
would_change_my_mind: If the free trial actually caught a duplicate or wrong total on the build that I had missed and paid, real money lost that is bigger than a year of the fee.
